name: n019_softcapgrid
purpose: Test whether soft-capping rare duration-predictor outliers preserves the W-NT I/L privacy gain from duration extrapolation 0.5 while reducing its WER cost.
launch_method: sbatch --wrap: base64-decoded job body, no writable shared script path required
stop_conditions: Stop the current condition on non-finite loss or repeated DCU watchdog failure.
Do not run LS360 E-VPC S until a soft-cap condition passes the full-test quality/W-NT Pareto check.
decision_rule: Prefer a condition that raises W-NT L toward 42.3 while retaining E-VPC S potential, with WER materially below the uncapped 8.267222% candidate and MOS no worse than the paper tolerance.

partial_result.note: Quality is close to the paper and much better than uncapped duration0.5; W-NT L still needs a bounded rerun.

causes: 1161272 used a login-node /dev/shm script path that was invisible on the compute node.
1161346 and 1161416 reached the preparation stage but the default python was Python 2 and/or TMPDIR pointed at the full /public filesystem.
/public is globally 100% full, so new shared logs and scripts cannot be created.
failed_submission.remedy: Use a base64 sbatch --wrap body, activate the N019 Python environment before patching, force TMPDIR to compute-node /dev/shm, and construct a symlink overlay instead of copying the full source tree.
